movelist.name: Crunch
movelist.effect: Crunch lowers the target’s Defense 1 Combat Stage on 17+

movelist.name: Swagger
movelist.effect: The target’s Attack is raised 2 Combat Stages. Swagger Confuses the target.

movelist.name: Embargo
movelist.effect: The target cannot use or benefit from held items for the remainder of the encounter. Embargo may only affect one target at a time; if Embargo is used on a new target, the previous target is freed from the effect.

movelist.name: Mud-Slap
movelist.effect: The target’s Accuracy is lowered by -1.

movelist.name: Assurance
movelist.effect: When you hit with Assurance, if Assurance’s target has already been damaged by a Move on the same round Assurance is being used, Assurance has a Damage Base of 12 (3d12+10 / 30) instead. This effect may trigger only once per Scene per Target.

movelist.name: Sand Tomb
movelist.effect: The target is put in a Vortex.

abilities.name: Intimidate
abilities.effect: Lower the target’s Attack 1 Combat Stage. You may target a specific foe only once per Scene with Intimidate.

abilities.name: Deep Sleep
abilities.effect: When asleep, this Pokémon restores a Tick of Hit Points at the end of each turn.
